title: card.usage.test Request Application Programming Interface (API) Schema
description: Run a test simulation to estimate how long your device data will last before reaching its quota limit.

days.description: Number of days to analyze for the test. If you want to analyze a period shorter than one day, use the `hours` argument instead.

hours.description: Number of hours to analyze for the test. Use this argument if you want to analyze a period shorter than one day. Cannot be used with the `days` argument.

megabytes.description: The Notecard lifetime data quota (in megabytes) to use for the test. This represents the total amount of data your device is allowed to consume over its lifetime.
